newsitem.title: USA: Iraq to submit oil pricing formula Tuesday - source.
newsitem.headline: Iraq to submit oil pricing formula Tuesday - source.

text.p: Iraq will submit its pricing formula for second round of oil exports under the "oil-for-food" scheme" in the next few hours, according to a well-placed Arab envoy, who did not want to be indentified.
"The formula is coming out of Baghdad, but we are expecting it sometime today, in the next few hours," said the Arab diplomat.
Once U.N. overseers receive Baghdad's pricing mechanism, the formula is sent with a recommendation to the U.N. sanctions committee.

Diplomats on the committee said the pricing mechanism will be circulated to all 15 committee members under "no-objection procedures," meaning that if no objection is made before a 48-hour limit expires, then the Iraqi formula is approved and oil sales can start.
U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan on Monday formally approved Iraq's humanitarian aid distribution plan, freeing Iraq to put forth the pricing formula to trigger oil sales.
Under terms of the oil accord, Iraq is allowed to sell $2.14 billion of oil over 180 days in two equal installments, with the period starting June 8.
